info.title: Kling 4.0 Video Generation Task - Query Task
info.description: Query Kling 4.0 video generation task status via `/kling/tasks`, covering text-to-video, image-to-video, and omni reference video tasks. Supports batch queries by system task ID or custom task ID. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); task results do not return these types yet.

get.description: Query Kling 4.0 video generation task status via `/kling/tasks`, covering text-to-video, image-to-video, and omni reference video tasks. This API only supports non-realtime/asynchronous tasks. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); task results do not return these types yet.

parameters.name: task_ids
parameters.description: System-defined task IDs to query. Use exactly one of `task_ids` or `external_task_ids`. Supports batch queries; separate multiple IDs with commas.

parameters.name: external_task_ids
parameters.description: Custom task IDs to query. Use exactly one of `task_ids` or `external_task_ids`. Supports batch queries; separate multiple IDs with commas.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

type.description:
Result type. Video generation tasks usually return `video`; fields differ by content type.

Note: `element` and `voice` result types are not yet integrated and are not returned yet.

id.description: System-generated result ID (returned for video, audio, voice, and element types).

url.description: URL of the generated result in hotlink-protected format. Generated images and videos are cleaned up after 30 days, so transfer them promptly.

watermark_url.description: Download URL of the watermarked result in hotlink-protected format.

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds. Returned only for video results.

group_id.description: Present only for image series, marking the group relationship.

status.description: Task status: submitted, processing, succeeded, or failed.

message.description: Task status message; on failure it shows the reason, such as platform content moderation.

create_time.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

update_time.description: Task update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: Custom task ID of this task, if any.

output_duration.description: Final target duration in seconds. Video generation is billed by this value.

billing.description: Multiple entries are returned when a task consumes multiple account balance types.

charge_type.description: Account type consumed: `cash` for balance or `unit` for resource packages.

amount.description: Amount deducted. For `cash` it is the discounted price, for `unit` the number of credits; decimal.

list_price.description: List price of the deduction, only for `charge_type=cash`.

code.description: Error code; 0 means success. See the error code documentation.

request_id.description: Request ID generated by the system for tracking and troubleshooting.

data.description: Task result list; multiple entries are returned for batch queries.
